push_channel_down.title: Real-time push updates are not being received
push_channel_down.description: The real-time push connection to RainPoint has been down for a while, so changes from your devices may be delayed. Your devices keep updating because polling every couple of minutes is still running as a fallback. If this keeps happening, try reloading the integration, or turn push updates off and back on in the integration options.

init.title: RainPoint Options
init.description: Enable real-time push updates, off by default. Polling is always retained as a fallback. Enable unverified generic sensors, off by default, to get provisional sensors for devices this integration does not support yet; these readings are derived from an unverified vendor catalog, may be wrong, are always labeled unverified in their names, and should not be relied on for automations. Generic sensors are only created for a device once every reading it reports has a verified definition, so many devices produce none at all. On this account that currently applies to {generic_eligible} of {generic_unsupported} unsupported devices.
